messages.author: 317fefd8e5bf9f73
messages.subject: Rapache/ExtJS and POST variables
parts:
Hi everyone,

I'm having some trouble using POST variables in Rapache with ExtJS.
The problem may be in ExtJS more than Rapache, but since others seemed
to be using this setup as well, I thought I'd ask here first.

You can see the page here (obviously this isn't the final goal, just
trying to get something simple working!)
http://70.32.83.100/brew/version1/itemselector2.html

Right now I'm working on passing variables from the form in the west
panel to a message pop-up and the XTemplate in the south panel (see
page). Since the Ajax request and XTemplate seem to be working (south
panel gets updated correctly), I thought I'd take the next step and
pass the form input to R, do something basic, and return them. The R
output is set to appear in the pop-up window, as seen below in the
code excerpt for the west panel button handler.

Unfortunately, submitting this form returns 10000 in the pop-up
message seeming to indicate that POST$snumber and POST$fnumber are
both null (see code below). These POST variables show up correctly in
the Firebug Net tab (unless I am calling them incorrectly?) so I'm
wondering if somehow the function isn't getting "re-brewed" after the
form is posted and the variables become non-null. I'm not entirely
clear on the order of operations, so I might just be including
something in the wrong spot? I may be missing something obvious as I
haven't been using ExtJS (or even javascript) for very long.

I've managed to use POST variables with Rapache in a html page without
any problems, and as you can see in the north panel, Rapache seems to
be running correctly.

And ideas would be much appreciated!

Thanks,
Laura

/*! --------------------- Define R function ------------------------
*/
function RapacheLP() {
<%
Rfunction<-function(){
aa<-ifelse(!is.null(POST$fnumber),
fromJSON(as.character(POST$fnumber)), 1)
bb<-ifelse(!is.null(POST$Snumber),
fromJSON(as.character(POST$snumber)), 9999)
cc<-aa+bb
return(toJSON(cc))
} %>
var summing = <%= Rfunction() %>;
return(summing);
};

/*! --------------------- Define the handler function for the form
submission ------------------------ */

var fn_submitForm2 = function(button, event){
var f = Ext.getCmp('Western');
if(f.getForm().isValid()==true){
var muchstuff= f.getForm().getFieldValues();
Ext.Ajax.request({
url: 'itemselector2.html',
method: 'POST',
params: {
fnumber:
Ext.encode(muchstuff.fnumber),
snumber: Ext.encode(muchstuff.snumber)
},
success: function(o) {
var tpl = new Ext.XTemplate(
'<p>First number: {fnumber}</br>
Second number: {snumber}</p>'
);
tpl.overwrite(Spanel.body, muchstuff);
f.getForm().reset();
}
});
var summing = RapacheLP();
Ext.Msg.alert('Submitted Values', 'The following
will be sent to the server: <br /> Your numbers are '+
Ext.encode(muchstuff.fnumber) + ' and ' +
Ext.encode(muchstuff.snumber) + ' and Rapache output is ' +
Ext.encode(summing) + '.');

}else{
alert('Stop trying to break something!');
}
};
